_comment: Background-music library for `manim-kit render`. Text only: the MP3s are
fetched into ~/.cache/manim-kit/music/ by `manim-kit music fetch`, never committed.
The real 3Blue1Brown music (Vincent Rubinetti) is all rights reserved and licensed
- it cannot be shipped or auto-fetched by a tool. These are CC BY tracks with a
Rejected sources and why: Pixabay (terms forbid scripted collection and bulk
copying), Blue Dot Sessions (free tier is CC BY-NC), Free Music Archive (download
endpoint is login-gated, old API dead), Scott Buckley (CC BY plus added terms
against redistributing the files standalone - fetch-on-demand only, never re-host),
Kai Engel (mixed per album, several NC).
Every entry needs a credit line that the user must put in the video description.
sha256 is verified after download; a mismatch is an error, not a warning.
